title: Elementary
description: Understand common sentences about familiar things, handle routine tasks, and talk about the past, plans and simple needs.

id.title: Dasar Lanjut
id.description: Memahami kalimat umum tentang hal yang dekat, menyelesaikan tugas rutin, serta menceritakan masa lalu, rencana dan kebutuhan sederhana.

nodes.title: Past Simple (Regular)
nodes.summary: Talk about finished actions with regular -ed verbs, their spelling and past time markers.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about finished actions and events in the past using regular verbs and time expressions.

objectives.text: Form regular past simple verbs and spell them correctly (stopped, studied)
Use time markers like yesterday, last week and ago

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday I walk to work.
I studyed hard for the test.
commonErrors.right: I studied hard for the test.

commonErrors.wrong: I visited Bali two years before.
commonErrors.right: I visited Bali two years ago.

id.title: Past Simple (Beraturan)
id.summary: Membicarakan kejadian yang sudah selesai dengan kata kerja -ed, ejaannya, dan penanda waktu lampau.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan kegiatan dan kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lalu dengan kata kerja beraturan dan keterangan waktu.

objectives.form-regular-past: Membentuk kata kerja past simple beraturan dengan ejaan yang benar (stopped, studied)
objectives.use-time-markers: Memakai penanda waktu seperti yesterday, last week dan ago

nodes.title: Past Simple (Irregular)
nodes.summary: Common irregular past forms (went, had, saw, made) plus negatives and questions with did.
nodes.canDo: Can describe past events and ask and answer simple questions about them, using common irregular verbs.

objectives.text: Use common irregular past forms (went, had, saw, made)
Make negatives and questions with did + base verb (didn't go, not didn't went)

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday I go to the market.
commonErrors.right: Yesterday I went to the market.

commonErrors.wrong: I didn't went to school.
Did you saw the film?

id.title: Past Simple (Tidak Beraturan)
id.summary: Bentuk lampau tidak beraturan yang umum (went, had, saw, made), serta kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan dengan did.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan kejadian di masa lalu serta bertanya dan menjawab tentangnya dengan kata kerja tidak beraturan yang umum.

objectives.use-common-irregular: Memakai bentuk lampau tidak beraturan yang umum (went, had, saw, made)
objectives.did-negatives-questions: Membuat kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan dengan did + kata kerja dasar (didn't go, bukan didn't went)

nodes.title: Past Continuous (Intro)
nodes.summary: Use was/were + -ing to say what was happening at a particular time in the past.
nodes.canDo: Can say what they and other people were doing at a particular time in the past.

objectives.text: Form the past continuous with was/were + -ing
Describe an action in progress at a past time (At 8 I was having dinner)

commonErrors.wrong: They was watching TV.
At 8 I was have dinner.
At 8 last night I am cooking.
commonErrors.right: At 8 last night I was cooking.

id.title: Past Continuous (Pengenalan)
id.summary: Memakai was/were + -ing untuk menyatakan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan apa yang sedang kamu dan orang lain lakukan pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu.

objectives.action-in-progress: Menjelaskan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu (At 8 I was having dinner)

nodes.title: Could & Polite Requests
nodes.summary: Use could/couldn't for past ability, and Could you …? / Could I …? for polite requests and permission.
nodes.canDo: Can say what they could or couldn't do in the past and make polite requests and ask for permission.

objectives.text: Use could/couldn't for past ability
Make polite requests with Could you …?
Ask for permission with Could I …?

commonErrors.wrong: When I was five, I can swim.
commonErrors.right: When I was five, I could swim.

commonErrors.wrong: Could you to help me?
I couldn't went to the party.
commonErrors.right: I couldn't go to the party.

id.title: Could & Permintaan Sopan
id.summary: Memakai could/couldn't untuk kemampuan di masa lalu, serta Could you …? / Could I …? untuk permintaan sopan dan izin.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan apa yang dulu bisa atau tidak bisa kamu lakukan, serta meminta tolong dan meminta izin dengan sopan.

objectives.past-ability: Memakai could/couldn't untuk kemampuan di masa lalu
objectives.polite-requests: Meminta tolong dengan sopan memakai Could you …?

nodes.title: Future with Going To
nodes.summary: Plans and predictions from evidence with going to, plus the present continuous for fixed arrangements.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about their plans and arrangements and make predictions based on what they can see.

objectives.text: Talk about plans with going to
Make predictions from what you see (Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.)
Use the present continuous for fixed arrangements (I'm meeting Sari on Friday)

commonErrors.wrong: I going to visit my grandma.
commonErrors.right: I'm going to visit my grandma.

commonErrors.wrong: She is going to buys a car.
commonErrors.right: She is going to buy a car.

commonErrors.wrong: Tomorrow I meet Sari at the cafe at 5.
commonErrors.right: Tomorrow I'm meeting Sari at the cafe at 5.

id.title: Masa Depan dengan Going To
id.summary: Rencana dan prediksi berdasarkan bukti dengan going to, serta present continuous untuk janji yang sudah terjadwal.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan rencana dan janji temu, serta membuat prediksi berdasarkan apa yang kamu lihat.

objectives.make-predictions-from: Membuat prediksi dari apa yang kamu lihat (Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.)
objectives.fixed-arrangements: Memakai present continuous untuk janji yang sudah terjadwal (I'm meeting Sari on Friday)

nodes.title: Will
nodes.summary: Use will for predictions, offers, promises and decisions made at the moment of speaking.
nodes.canDo: Can make simple predictions, offers and promises, and say what they decide to do on the spot.

objectives.text: Make predictions with will (I think it will rain)
Make offers and promises with will (I'll help you)
Use will for decisions made at the moment of speaking

commonErrors.wrong: I will to call you tonight.
I think it will raining.
The phone's ringing. I answer it.
commonErrors.right: The phone's ringing. I'll answer it.

id.title: Will
id.summary: Memakai will untuk prediksi, tawaran, janji, dan keputusan yang diambil saat itu juga.
id.canDo: Bisa membuat prediksi sederhana, menawarkan bantuan, berjanji, dan menyampaikan keputusan yang diambil saat itu juga.

objectives.predictions: Membuat prediksi dengan will (I think it will rain)
objectives.offers-promises: Menawarkan bantuan dan berjanji dengan will (I'll help you)
objectives.spontaneous-decisions: Memakai will untuk keputusan spontan saat berbicara

nodes.title: Present Perfect (Intro)
nodes.summary: Form have/has + past participle and use it for experiences (ever/never) and recent news (just/already/yet).
nodes.canDo: Can talk about their experiences and about things that have or haven't happened recently.

objectives.text: Form the present perfect with have/has + past participle
Talk about experiences with ever and never
Use just, already and yet

commonErrors.wrong: I have saw that film.
Have you ever went to Japan?
commonErrors.right: Have you ever been to Japan?

commonErrors.wrong: I already finish my homework.

id.title: Present Perfect (Pengenalan)
id.summary: Membentuk have/has + past participle untuk pengalaman (ever/never) dan kabar terbaru (just/already/yet).
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan pengalaman dan hal yang sudah atau belum terjadi baru-baru ini.

objectives.form-present-perfect: Membentuk present perfect dengan have/has + past participle
objectives.experiences-ever-never: Membicarakan pengalaman dengan ever dan never

nodes.title: Comparatives & Superlatives
nodes.summary: Compare things with bigger, more expensive, the best and as … as / not as … as.
nodes.canDo: Can compare people, places and things in simple terms.

objectives.text: Compare two things with comparatives (bigger, more expensive)
Describe extremes with superlatives (the best, the most expensive)
Compare with as … as and not as … as

commonErrors.wrong: Jakarta is more big than Bandung.
Bali is smaller from Java.
This is the most cheap hotel.

id.title: Perbandingan & Superlatif
id.summary: Membandingkan dengan bigger, more expensive, the best, dan as … as / not as … as.
id.canDo: Bisa membandingkan orang, tempat, dan benda secara sederhana.

objectives.compare-two-things: Membandingkan dua hal dengan comparative (bigger, more expensive)
objectives.describe-extremes-with: Menyatakan yang paling dengan superlative (the best, the most expensive)
objectives.as-as: Membandingkan dengan as … as dan not as … as

nodes.title: Adverbs of Manner & Degree
nodes.summary: Say how people do things with -ly and irregular adverbs, and make words stronger with quite, really and very.
nodes.canDo: Can describe how people do things and make descriptions stronger or weaker.

objectives.text: Form adverbs with -ly and use irregular ones (fast, well, hard)
Choose between an adjective and an adverb (a good driver / drives well)
Use quite, really and very to change how strong a word is

commonErrors.wrong: He drives very good.
She speaks English fluent.
I very like it.

id.title: Adverb Cara & Tingkat
id.summary: Menyatakan cara melakukan sesuatu dengan adverb -ly dan tidak beraturan, serta menguatkan kata dengan quite, really dan very.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan bagaimana orang melakukan sesuatu dan menguatkan atau melemahkan deskripsi.

objectives.form-adverbs: Membentuk adverb dengan -ly dan memakai adverb tidak beraturan (fast, well, hard)
objectives.adjective-vs-adverb: Memilih antara kata sifat dan adverb (a good driver / drives well)
objectives.degree-words: Memakai quite, really dan very untuk mengatur kuat-lemahnya kata

nodes.title: Quantifiers
nodes.summary: Talk about amounts with much, many, a lot of, a few, a little, too much and too many.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about quantities of things, including when there is too much or too many.

objectives.text: Use much, many and a lot of with countable and uncountable nouns
Use a few and a little
Say there is too much or too many of something

commonErrors.wrong: How much people came?
I have a few money.
There are too much cars in Jakarta.
commonErrors.right: There are too many cars in Jakarta.

id.title: Kata Penunjuk Jumlah
id.summary: Menyatakan jumlah dengan much, many, a lot of, a few, a little, too much dan too many.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan jumlah sesuatu, termasuk saat jumlahnya terlalu banyak.

objectives.much-many-a-lot-of: Memakai much, many dan a lot of dengan kata benda yang dapat dan tidak dapat dihitung
objectives.a-few-a-little: Memakai a few dan a little
objectives.too-much-too-many: Menyatakan sesuatu terlalu banyak dengan too much atau too many

nodes.title: Should, Have To & Must
nodes.summary: Give advice with should and talk about rules and obligations with have to, must, mustn't and don't have to.
nodes.canDo: Can give simple advice and explain what is necessary, not necessary or not allowed.

objectives.text: Give advice with should and shouldn't
Talk about obligation with have to and must
Tell the difference between mustn't and don't have to

commonErrors.wrong: You should to rest.
She have to work on Saturday.
commonErrors.right: She has to work on Saturday.

commonErrors.wrong: It's a holiday tomorrow, so you mustn't come to work.
commonErrors.right: It's a holiday tomorrow, so you don't have to come to work.

id.title: Should, Have To & Must
id.summary: Memberi saran dengan should, serta membicarakan aturan dan kewajiban dengan have to, must, mustn't dan don't have to.
id.canDo: Bisa memberi saran sederhana dan menjelaskan apa yang wajib, tidak wajib, atau dilarang.

objectives.advice-should: Memberi saran dengan should dan shouldn't
objectives.obligation-have-to-must: Membicarakan kewajiban dengan have to dan must
objectives.mustnt-vs-dont-have-to: Membedakan mustn't (dilarang) dan don't have to (tidak wajib)

nodes.title: Possessive Pronouns
nodes.summary: Say who things belong to with mine, yours, theirs, Whose …? and 's / s'.
nodes.canDo: Can ask and say who things belong to.

objectives.text: Use mine, yours, his, hers, ours and theirs
Ask and answer with Whose …? (Whose is this? It's mine.)
Use 's and s' correctly (my sister's room, my parents' house)

commonErrors.wrong: This bag is my.
That's the book of my friend.
my parent's house (for both parents)

id.title: Kata Ganti Kepemilikan
id.summary: Menyatakan pemilik sesuatu dengan mine, yours, theirs, Whose …? serta 's / s'.
id.canDo: Bisa menanyakan dan menyatakan milik siapa suatu benda.

objectives.possessive-pronouns: Memakai mine, yours, his, hers, ours dan theirs
objectives.whose-questions: Bertanya dan menjawab dengan Whose …? (Whose is this? It's mine.)
objectives.apostrophe-s: Memakai 's dan s' dengan benar (my sister's room, my parents' house)

nodes.title: Verb + -ing / To-Infinitive
nodes.summary: Which verbs take to (want, decide) and which take -ing (enjoy, finish), plus to for purpose.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about wants, plans and likes using the right verb pattern, and explain why they did something.

objectives.text: Use want, need, hope and decide + to-infinitive
Use enjoy, finish and mind + -ing
Use to to explain purpose (I went to the bank to get money)

commonErrors.wrong: I want go home.
I enjoy to swim.
I went to the bank for get money.
commonErrors.right: I went to the bank to get money.

id.title: Kata Kerja + -ing / To-Infinitive
id.summary: Kata kerja yang diikuti to (want, decide) dan yang diikuti -ing (enjoy, finish), serta to untuk menyatakan tujuan.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan keinginan, rencana dan kesukaan dengan pola kata kerja yang tepat, serta menjelaskan tujuan melakukan sesuatu.

objectives.verb-to-infinitive: Memakai want, need, hope dan decide + to-infinitive
objectives.to-for-purpose: Memakai to untuk menyatakan tujuan (I went to the bank to get money)

nodes.title: Zero & First Conditional (Intro)
nodes.summary: Talk about general facts and real future possibilities with if, and know when to use when instead.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about general facts and real possibilities in the future and their results.

objectives.text: Use the zero conditional for general facts (If you heat ice, it melts)
Use the first conditional for real possibilities (If it rains, I'll stay home)
Choose between if (maybe) and when (sure to happen)

commonErrors.wrong: If it will rain, I'll stay home.
commonErrors.right: If it rains, I'll stay home.

commonErrors.wrong: If you heat ice, it will melts.
commonErrors.right: If you heat ice, it melts.

commonErrors.wrong: If I get home tonight, I'll call you. (it is certain)
commonErrors.right: When I get home tonight, I'll call you.

id.title: Zero & First Conditional (Pengenalan)
id.summary: Membicarakan fakta umum dan kemungkinan nyata di masa depan dengan if, serta kapan memakai when.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan fakta umum dan kemungkinan nyata di masa depan beserta akibatnya.

objectives.zero-conditional: Memakai zero conditional untuk fakta umum (If you heat ice, it melts)
objectives.first-conditional: Memakai first conditional untuk kemungkinan nyata (If it rains, I'll stay home)
objectives.if-vs-when: Memilih antara if (mungkin terjadi) dan when (pasti terjadi)

nodes.title: Linking Words for Stories
nodes.summary: Put events in order with first, then, next, finally, before, after and when, and show results with so.
nodes.canDo: Can tell a simple story or describe a sequence of events using basic linking words.

objectives.text: Order events with first, then, next and finally
Link events with before, after and when
Show a result with so

commonErrors.wrong: Because it rained, so I stayed home.
commonErrors.right: It rained, so I stayed home.

commonErrors.wrong: After I finished work, then I went home.
commonErrors.right: After I finished work, I went home.

id.title: Kata Penghubung untuk Bercerita
id.summary: Mengurutkan kejadian dengan first, then, next, finally, before, after dan when, serta menyatakan akibat dengan so.
id.canDo: Bisa bercerita sederhana atau menjelaskan urutan kejadian dengan kata penghubung dasar.

objectives.sequence-words: Mengurutkan kejadian dengan first, then, next dan finally
objectives.before-after-when: Menghubungkan kejadian dengan before, after dan when

nodes.title: Common Phrasal Verbs
nodes.summary: Everyday phrasal verbs like get up, turn on/off, look for and put on, in context and in your routine.
nodes.canDo: Can understand and use common everyday phrasal verbs, for example when describing a daily routine.

objectives.text: Use everyday phrasal verbs (get up, turn on/off, look for, put on)
Understand the meaning of phrasal verbs from context
Use phrasal verbs to describe your routine

commonErrors.wrong: Please open the light.
I'm looking my keys.
It's cold. Put on it.

id.title: Phrasal Verb Umum
id.summary: Phrasal verb sehari-hari seperti get up, turn on/off, look for dan put on, dalam konteks dan rutinitasmu.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami dan memakai phrasal verb sehari-hari, misalnya saat menceritakan rutinitas.

objectives.everyday-phrasal-verbs: Memakai phrasal verb sehari-hari (get up, turn on/off, look for, put on)
objectives.meaning-from-context: Memahami arti phrasal verb dari konteks
objectives.describe-routine: Memakai phrasal verb untuk menceritakan rutinitasmu

nodes.title: Travel & Holidays
nodes.summary: Words for airports, hotels and tickets, prepositions of movement and holiday activities.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about travel arrangements, describe a route and say what they do on holiday.

objectives.text: Use words for airports, hotels and tickets
Use prepositions of movement (into, across, along, past)
Talk about holiday activities

commonErrors.wrong: We go to holiday in Lombok.
commonErrors.right: We go on holiday in Lombok.

commonErrors.wrong: Walk pass the bank and turn left.
commonErrors.right: Walk past the bank and turn left.

commonErrors.wrong: We went into the bus.

id.title: Perjalanan & Liburan
id.summary: Kosakata bandara, hotel dan tiket, preposisi gerak, serta kegiatan liburan.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan persiapan perjalanan, menjelaskan rute, dan menceritakan kegiatan saat liburan.

objectives.airport-hotel-tickets: Memakai kosakata bandara, hotel dan tiket
objectives.prepositions-of-movement: Memakai preposisi gerak (into, across, along, past)

nodes.title: Health & Feelings
nodes.summary: Common symptoms and illnesses, words for the doctor's and the pharmacy, and basic feelings.
nodes.canDo: Can say how they feel, physically and emotionally, and describe common health problems.

objectives.text: Name common symptoms and illnesses (headache, fever)
Use key words at the doctor's and the pharmacy
Describe basic feelings (worried, happy, angry)

commonErrors.wrong: I am headache.
My body is hot.
I'm boring at home.

id.title: Kesehatan & Perasaan
id.summary: Gejala dan penyakit umum, kosakata di dokter dan apotek, serta perasaan dasar.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan kondisi tubuh dan perasaanmu, serta menjelaskan masalah kesehatan yang umum.

objectives.symptoms-illnesses: Menyebutkan gejala dan penyakit umum (headache, fever)
objectives.doctor-pharmacy: Memakai kosakata penting di dokter dan apotek

nodes.title: Work, Study & Technology
nodes.summary: Words for jobs and workplaces, school and university, and basic technology (email, app, download, password).
nodes.canDo: Can talk simply about their work or studies and the technology they use every day.

objectives.text: Talk about tasks and places at work
Use words for school and university
Use basic technology words (email, app, download, password)

commonErrors.wrong: I work as accountant.
I have many homeworks.
commonErrors.right: I have a lot of homework.

commonErrors.wrong: I forgot my password, so I can't login.
commonErrors.right: I forgot my password, so I can't log in.

id.title: Kerja, Studi & Teknologi
id.summary: Kosakata pekerjaan dan tempat kerja, sekolah dan kuliah, serta teknologi dasar (email, app, download, password).
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan pekerjaan atau studimu dan teknologi yang kamu pakai sehari-hari secara sederhana.

objectives.workplace-tasks: Membicarakan tugas dan tempat di lingkungan kerja
objectives.basic-technology: Memakai kosakata teknologi dasar (email, app, download, password)

nodes.title: Describing People
nodes.summary: Describe appearance and personality, and compare people.
nodes.canDo: Can describe what people look like and what they are like, and compare them.

objectives.text: Describe appearance
Describe personality with suitable adjectives
Compare people (My brother is taller than me)

commonErrors.wrong: She has long black hairs.
She has hair long.
He is very friendly person.
commonErrors.right: He is a very friendly person.

id.title: Mendeskripsikan Orang
id.summary: Mendeskripsikan penampilan dan kepribadian, serta membandingkan orang.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan penampilan dan sifat seseorang, serta membandingkan orang.

objectives.describe-personality-with: Mendeskripsikan kepribadian dengan kata sifat yang tepat
objectives.compare-people: Membandingkan orang (My brother is taller than me)

nodes.title: -ed Endings & Weak Forms
nodes.summary: Say -ed endings as /t/, /d/ or /ɪd/, and use and hear schwa weak forms of was, can, to and of.
nodes.canDo: Can pronounce past -ed endings clearly and recognise weak forms in natural speech.

objectives.text: Say -ed endings as /t/, /d/ or /ɪd/ (worked, played, wanted)
Use schwa and the weak forms of was, can, to and of
Recognise weak forms in spoken sentences

commonErrors.wrong: worked said as 'work-ed' with an extra /ɪd/ syllable
commonErrors.right: worked as one syllable ending in /t/ /wɜːkt/

commonErrors.wrong: played said as 'play', with the final /d/ dropped
can and to always said in full: /kæn/, /tuː/
commonErrors.right: weak forms in sentences: I can go /aɪ kən ɡəʊ/, want to /wɒnt tə/

id.title: Akhiran -ed & Weak Forms
id.summary: Mengucapkan akhiran -ed sebagai /t/, /d/ atau /ɪd/, serta memakai dan mengenali weak form was, can, to dan of.
id.canDo: Bisa mengucapkan akhiran -ed dengan jelas dan mengenali weak forms dalam ucapan alami.

objectives.ed-endings: Mengucapkan akhiran -ed sebagai /t/, /d/ atau /ɪd/ (worked, played, wanted)
objectives.schwa-weak-forms: Memakai schwa dan weak form dari was, can, to dan of
objectives.hear-weak-forms: Mengenali weak forms dalam kalimat lisan

nodes.title: Sentence Stress & Linking
nodes.summary: Stress the content words, link consonants to vowels (turn_off, an_apple) and keep a natural rhythm.
nodes.canDo: Can speak short sentences with clear stress, linking and a natural rhythm.

objectives.text: Stress the content words in a sentence
Link a final consonant to the next vowel (turn_off, an_apple)
Keep a natural rhythm in short sentences

commonErrors.wrong: every word stressed equally: I WANT TO GO TO THE SHOP
commonErrors.right: stress the content words: I WANT to GO to the SHOP

commonErrors.wrong: turn off said as two separate words with a pause
an apple with a stop between the words: 'an | apple'

id.title: Tekanan Kalimat & Linking
id.summary: Menekan kata isi, menyambung konsonan ke vokal (turn_off, an_apple), dan menjaga ritme yang alami.
id.canDo: Bisa mengucapkan kalimat pendek dengan tekanan, sambungan bunyi, dan ritme yang alami.

objectives.content-word-stress: Memberi tekanan pada kata isi dalam kalimat
objectives.consonant-vowel-linking: Menyambung konsonan akhir ke vokal berikutnya (turn_off, an_apple)
objectives.short-sentence-rhythm: Menjaga ritme alami dalam kalimat pendek

nodes.title: Practical Listening
nodes.summary: Catch key information in announcements, directions, instructions and short conversations.
nodes.canDo: Can understand simple announcements, directions and the main point of short, clear conversations.

objectives.text: Understand key information in airport and station announcements
Follow directions and simple instructions
Catch the main point of short conversations

id.title: Menyimak Praktis
id.summary: Menangkap informasi penting dari pengumuman, petunjuk arah, instruksi, dan percakapan pendek.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami pengumuman sederhana, petunjuk arah, dan poin utama percakapan pendek yang jelas.

objectives.announcements: Memahami informasi penting dari pengumuman di bandara dan stasiun
objectives.directions-instructions: Mengikuti petunjuk arah dan instruksi sederhana

nodes.title: Everyday Reading
nodes.summary: Read short emails, messages, simple articles and stories, and guess new words from context.
nodes.canDo: Can understand short, simple everyday texts such as emails, messages and simple stories.

objectives.text: Understand short emails and messages
Understand simple articles and stories
Guess the meaning of new words from context

id.title: Membaca Sehari-hari
id.summary: Membaca email, pesan pendek, artikel dan cerita sederhana, serta menebak arti kata baru dari konteks.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami teks sehari-hari yang pendek dan sederhana, seperti email, pesan, dan cerita sederhana.

objectives.guess-from-context: Menebak arti kata baru dari konteks

nodes.title: Talking About Past & Plans
nodes.summary: Tell someone about your weekend or holiday, share your plans and answer follow-up questions.
nodes.canDo: Can describe past activities and future plans in simple terms and answer follow-up questions.

objectives.text: Tell someone about your weekend or holiday
Talk about your plans
Answer follow-up questions with extra detail

commonErrors.wrong: Last weekend I go to the beach with my family.
commonErrors.right: Last weekend I went to the beach with my family.

id.title: Bercerita tentang Masa Lalu & Rencana
